verdict.rationale: The Comptroller's open-data page says it publishes machine-readable raw datasets, and a probe confirmed one of its datasets answers a keyless SODA JSON query on data.texas.gov. However, that API rail belongs to the state Socrata portal, and the Comptroller's own pages document no endpoints. All OpenAPI/swagger paths return 404. missing for 10: published endpoint documentation on the Comptroller's own pages, a key-issuance path, stated rate limits, an OpenAPI or API reference.
